subtitles.en: A Moabite widow's loyalty and the lineage of David

descriptions.en: A short pastoral narrative set during the era of the judges. Ruth, a Moabite widow, follows her mother-in-law Naomi back to Bethlehem and marries Boaz; the genealogy at the end identifies her as great-grandmother of King David.
